description: This is a Java source file defining the MediaNotificationManager class, which manages media playback notifications for an Android media app. It updates notifications based on MediaSession state, handles user actions like play/pause/next/prev, and maintains interaction with MediaController and MediaSession.

classes.name: MediaNotificationManager
classes.description: Manages media playback notifications, updating UI based on MediaSession state, handling user actions, and ensuring foreground notification persists during playback.

methods.name: MediaNotificationManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing the notification manager, setting up session token, notification intents, and clearing existing notifications.

methods.name: startNotification
methods.description: Starts tracking MediaSession and posts ongoing notification. Registers callback and receiver for media controls.

methods.name: stopNotification
methods.description: Stops tracking MediaSession, unregisters callback and receiver, and removes notification.

methods.name: onReceive
methods.description: Handles broadcast intents for media control actions (play/pause/next/prev).

methods.name: updateSessionToken
methods.description: Updates the MediaSession token and reconnects to MediaController if session token has changed.

methods.name: createContentIntent
methods.description: Creates intent to launch media player UI when notification is tapped.

methods.name: mCb
methods.description: Callback for MediaController events: updates notification on playback state or metadata changes, or session destruction.

methods.name: createNotification
methods.description: Builds and returns the media playback notification based on current MediaMetadata and PlaybackState.

methods.name: addPlayPauseAction
methods.description: Adds play or pause action button to notification depending on current playback state.

methods.name: setNotificationPlaybackState
methods.description: Updates notification appearance based on playback position and state, and stops foreground when not playing.

methods.name: fetchBitmapFromURLAsync
methods.description: Fetches album art asynchronously to update notification with artwork.
